weather_report:
As night envelops Boston, the air carries a chill that hints at the approaching dawn. The skies are partly clouded, with a murmur of wind swirling around at a gentle pace, ushering in a night that hovers around freezing. The city, adorned in twinkling lights, stands quiet under a canopy of stars just peeking through the clouds, promising a clearer day ahead.

Tomorrow brings the allure of sunshine, a rare treat in this season, with temperatures poised to rise ever so slightly. A brisk northwest wind will accompany the daylight, invigorating the atmosphere and banishing the cold, albeit momentarily. As one prepares for the day, layering becomes essential—not heavy winter coats, but light sweaters beneath a jacket, ready to be shed when the sun’s rays warm the skin.  Embrace the charm of this pleasant Sunday. Perhaps stroll through a local park, savoring a warm drink while the world awakens around you, or engage in a leisurely afternoon of reading by a window, absorbing the sunlight as you lose yourself in the pages of a favorite book.
